_comment_canonical: CANONICAL top-level A40 P&R config. Last validated by SGE job 5392 (2026-09-02): SS WNS -10.13 ns, TNS -383.5, antenna 0/0, DRC 0, XOR 0, LVS clean, util 66.1%, worst IR drop 3.61 mV VDD / 2.15 mV VSS. Job 5392 adds PDN_CORE_RING_CONNECT_TO_PADS and exactly reproduces job 5379's macro-level metrics; it confirms the option is safe but cannot validate a literal DVDD/DVSS connection because this macro contains zero pad cells. Supersedes job 5286 as the reference run: 5286 predates the 2026-09-01 Grouper-boundary removal from src/top/trouper_top.v and runs a different netlist (35670 vs 35300 cells), so its -18.23 ns SS WNS is NOT comparable -- the same-netlist stock-PDN control (job 5378) measures -11.17 ns. Do not attribute that ~7 ns to anything but the RTL change. Collapsed 2026-09-01 from the trouper_top_dbgpins.json variant chain, then again 2026-09-02 from the trouper_top_pdn_* PDN trial chain (_pdn / _thickonly / _ring5 / _widthonly, deleted as superseded). Every knob below that differs from a stock LibreLane run carries a _comment_ explaining which job established it -- change them only with a job number to point at.
_comment_cts_spi_sck: Open Risks #6 -- DRT-1231 pin-access failures on SPI_SCK clock buffers. MECHANISM: CTS has nothing below clkbuf_8 to reach for, so it drives 2-sink SPI_SCK leaf nets with clkbuf_16, the widest cell in the set, on an NDR net whose I pin the detailed router then cannot access (e.g. clkbuf_2_3__f_SPI_SCK/I, job 5281). TRIGGER: job 5281's only delta from the clean job 5279 was a 6-line reg_bank.v edit that grew the netlist 144 cells (35526 -> 35670) -- i.e. this failure is sensitive to netlist size, not to anything about SPI. ADOPTED FIX: the SPI_SCK CTS exclusion now in pnr_32m_scoped_v25_b6.sdc (commit 2f3393e, confirmed by job 5286), which makes SPI_SCK a plain routed net -- so nothing in P&R optimises those paths and item 54 (host-SPI post-route GLS/SDF) carries more weight. REJECTED, do not retry: (a) adding clkbuf_4 to CTS_CLK_BUFFERS (probe B / trouper_top_dbgpins_smallbuf.json, deleted; the library also has 1/2/3/20, 4 being the smallest step that keeps drive sane); (b) density probes at 63 % and 60 % (trouper_top_dbgpins_d63/_d60.json, deleted). Also do NOT remove clkbuf_16 from CTS_CLK_BUFFERS or downsize CTS_ROOT_BUFFER: job 5197 dropped clkbuf_16 from the list entirely and the failure simply moved to a clkbuf_12 on the IQ_CLK tree. The root buffer stays clkbuf_16 so the IQ_CLK root is untouched. STATUS: Open Risks #6 CLOSED 2026-09-03. The fix is no longer n=1 -- the Grouper-boundary removal perturbed the netlist by 370 cells (35670 -> 35300), 2.6x the 144-cell delta that originally triggered the failure, and five runs since (5378/5379/5392/5394/5413) routed clean with zero SPI_SCK DRT-1231. Job 5393 did fail DRT-0073, but on the IQ_CLK tree (clkbuf_2_1_0_IQ_CLK_regs/I) under a rejected PDN pitch -- different net, different code, not a recurrence. The REJECTED list above still stands: closure is not licence to re-roll these knobs. If DRT-1231 ever does recur on SPI_SCK, re-open #6 rather than tuning CTS.
_comment_drv_closure: DRV (max slew / max cap) closure, SGE job 5105 (t4b), 2026-08-27. Baseline job 4780 signed off with 1060/115 max-slew/max-cap violations at nom_tt (1963/160 at SS) because the only DRV repair ran on estimated parasitics and found the design ~clean. Enabling the post-GRT resizer-timing pass plus widening the design-repair slew/cap margins to 65% drops that to 10/4 (nom_tt) / 15/6 (SS), DRC/LVS clean, WNS unchanged (SS actually -16.97 -> -15.71). Do NOT add set_max_transition/set_max_capacitance to the SDC to push further: any design-wide value stalls repair_design on this netlist for 70+ min (trials t3/t5/t6). Residual ~15 pins are a documented waiver (quasi-static MCP-relaxed sc_detector-decode / training_acc cones + 2 output-path buffers).
_comment_drv_margin_sweep: 2026-09-03 sweep off job 5469 (27-pin, 7/1 max-slew/max-cap at nom_tt, 11/2 at SS). RECOMMENDED CHANGE, NOT YET APPLIED (waiting on an RTL merge -- re-verify against the merged netlist first): set GRT_DESIGN_REPAIR_MAX_SLEW_PCT and GRT_DESIGN_REPAIR_MAX_CAP_PCT to 50, LEAVE DESIGN_REPAIR_MAX_*_PCT at 65. Job 5491 (drvp1, GRT-only 50): nom_tt DRV 0/0, max_ff 0/0, SS 7/1, SS WNS -11.36 -> -10.56, SS TNS -276 -> -268, DRC/LVS/XOR/antenna 0, 49 FEWER cells, util unchanged -- strict win. Jobs 5492 (drvp2, all four -> 50) and 5489 (drvp3, all four -> 45) both REGRESSED HARD: nom_tt 17/5 and 120/15, SS TNS -487 and -1762. Mechanism: the pre-GRT (post-GPL) repair runs on crude placement-stage RC; an aggressive target there dumps buffers against bad estimates and wrecks routing + timing downstream. Only the post-GRT margin (global-route RC estimates) is a safe lever. There is NO post-detailed-route / post-RCX repair step in this LibreLane build, so pre-route headroom is the only way to absorb the estimated->extracted RC delta that leaves the residual DRV. See planning/drv-margin-sweep-2026-09-03.md.
_comment_antenna: Antenna closure, ported from job 5198 (config_1675_c5_diodepad4.json, zero antenna violations) onto this A40 FP_DEF_TEMPLATE flow and re-proven here. Three knobs carry it: DIODE_PADDING 4, DPL_CELL_PADDING 2 (down from 3 -- 3 causes DPL-0036, diodes failing to legalize at all), and mixed GRT/DRT antenna repair (jumper-only OFF on both). GRT_ANTENNA_REPAIR_MARGIN must stay ABSENT (library default): setting it to 90 drives far more aggressive repair rerouting and crashed OpenROAD at step 43 in job 5212 -- GRT-0243 'Unable to repair antennas on net with diodes' then GRT-0183 'Net net973: heap underflow during 3D maze routing'. PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT 65 (down from 72) was required alongside the margin removal: variant A (margin only, density 72) did not suffice, variant B (both) did, and job 5214 signed it off at 0 antenna / 0 DRC / 0 LVS. Do NOT downsize the clock tree to chase antenna -- diodes crowding IQ_CLK clkbufs was the original DRT-0073 cause.
_comment_klayout_drc: Explicitly OFF, and that is more honest than the default. LibreLane's 67-klayout-drc runs only if KLAYOUT_DRC_RUNSET is set; gf180mcuD does not set it, so with RUN_KLAYOUT_DRC true the step exited in 10 ms producing no report and no metric, and 69-checker-klayoutdrc then PASSED because klayout__drc_error__count was ABSENT rather than zero -- a silent false negative on every run in this design's history (Open Risks #58). It cannot simply be pointed at the guard: the step invokes `klayout -b -zz -r <script> -rd input=/topcell=/report=` and parses ONE .lyrdb (librelane/steps/klayout.py:486-540), whereas the GF180 deck is a Python driver fanning out into 63 tables and 63 reports. KLayout DRC signoff therefore runs OUT OF FLOW via rtl-test/scripts/klayout_drc_guarded.sh, which verifies every table actually ran before reporting counts. Last FULL signoff: job 5415 against the PREVIOUS shipped GDS (bridged, md5 f0e740b4...) -- 63/63 tables, 0 violations, 2h14m. THAT LAPSED 2026-09-04 and was RE-ESTABLISHED 2026-09-06: final/gds/trouper_top.gds is now P&R job 5682 (canonical config + the pdn_cfg.tcl M2/M3-only bridge keepout) with the 12 A40 PDN bridges re-inserted -- md5 c308505a425acdce2e6704273c5c524a. SGE job 5684 runs the full guarded 63-table deck against that md5 (61/63 clean at commit time incl. metal3/via2/metal4/metal5/via4 all 0; contact/metal1 pending -- bridges add no poly/contact/M1 geometry). Prior bridged GDSs: job 5650 FAILED this gate (job 5653: 12x M3.2a + 4x V2.1 on signal nets _20360_/_20338_/_18690_ through the north bridge via band); job 5674s M2-M5 keepout passed DRC but CUT the VDD-M5/VSS-M4 core rings and left the bridges floating; the M2/M3-only keepout fixes both. STANDING OBLIGATION: this is a MANUAL gate now -- nothing in the flow re-runs it, so any change that alters the GDS (a new P&R run, or re-running tools/build_a40_pdn_bridges.py) silently invalidates the signoff above and needs a fresh FULL run. The TABLES= subset does NOT satisfy that: it exists only to recover tables lost within a run against an UNCHANGED GDS, and reports PARTIAL precisely so it cannot be mistaken for one. Check the md5 before trusting the result above. UNTESTED alternative: the PDK's monolithic libs.tech/klayout/tech/drc/gf180mcu.drc IS the right shape for the step, but nobody has checked it honours input/topcell/report or dodges the mslot bug, and it would add hours to every P&R.
_comment_pdn_bridge_keepouts: pdn_cfg.tcl carries two hardcoded routing-only create_obstruction boxes (Metal2..Metal5, NOT Metal1) over the post-flow A40 PDN bridge landing zones from tools/build_a40_pdn_bridges.py -- north VDD fingers + west VSS fingers -- guarded on DIE_AREA so they fire only on the A40 ACV 1675x1110 die. ADDED 2026-09-06 after job 5653: the guarded 63-table KLayout DRC on job 5650's bridged GDS returned 12x M3.2a + 4x V2.1, ALL in the north bridge geometry, because the router ran two long high-fanout SIGNAL nets (_20360_/_20338_) along the sparse top edge straight through the bridge M3 via-enclosure band, and a bridge via2 column overlapped a base via2. The bridge script places by fixed absolute coordinates with no awareness of the routed result. Kept in pdn_cfg.tcl not here because LibreLane 2.x drops unrecognised config keys before the step env. Re-verify against the next guarded KLayout DRC and shrink the boxes to the minimum that clears.
_comment_a40: A40 padframe integration. Pin placement comes from the integrator floorplan template A40_ACV_rtlnames.def, regenerated 2026-09-03 by rtl-test/scripts/regen_a40_def.sh from the full 27-pin info.yaml (make -f chipathon2026-system/Makefile.padframe project-def-A40 in ip/chipathon-2026-padring-system, d-m-bailey/padring_chipathon2026 @ agent/project-padframe-makefile). 159 pin entries = 27 pads expanded to their full IO-cell control interface; ARRAY_ACQ_N (slot N15) and DBG0 (N16) now carry REAL generator coordinates, replacing the synthetic-coordinate A40_ACV_rtlnames_dbgpins.def stopgap. The tool selected variant ACV (1675x1110 um) as the smallest block variant fitting trouper_top.gds's 0/0 outline; the DEF also carries the ACV Metal2 corner routing blockage (BLOCKAGES section). a40_def_to_rtlnames.py is a pure pass-through now (RTL port names match the generator's <pad>_<terminal> convention verbatim since commit 6c50e12); VDD/VSS pin entries are kept in the DEF but FP_DEF_TEMPLATE matching filters POWER/GROUND bterms and the PDN builds its own. The 68 die-internal Grouper GRP_* / AHB H* / IRQ_GROUPER pins are gone (Grouper not taping out, 2026-09-01). Die follows the template: 1675x1110 (not Trouper's own 1650x1100). IO_PIN_ORDER_CFG is unused in this flow - io_placement_bl.cfg is kept only as the standalone (non-padframe) pin order.

_comment_density: PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT 65 is load-bearing on this 1675x1110 die, established by routability not by area. History: 78 % and 72 % both hit DRT-0073/DRT-1231 on this die; 65 % cleared it (job 5198) and every clean signoff since (5214/5279/5284/5286) has run at 65 %. The companion 72 % run of the antenna recipe, job 5213, failed in detailed routing with DRT-0073 pin-access errors on the newly-created SPI_SCK CTS tree -- 65 % provides the routing room that tree and the antenna diodes both need. Lowering further (63/60) was probed and rejected: see _comment_cts_spi_sck. Raising it back toward 72 % to recover area requires re-proving routing, not just timing.
_comment_pdn: PDN thickening + Metal4/Metal5 core ring, adopted from SGE job 5379 (2026-09-02). STRIPES: Metal4/Metal5 width 1.6 -> 4.0 um. PITCHES DELIBERATELY LEFT AT THE PDK DEFAULT (153.6 / 153.18) -- do not halve them. RING: 5 um on Metal4/Metal5, the layers with headroom (job 5378 GRT congestion: Metal4 2.4%, Metal5 10.8%, against Metal2 40.0% / Metal3 47.2%); explicitly NOT Metal2/Metal3 as the reference padring config does (ip/chipathon-2026-gf180mcu-padring/librelane/config.yaml), which would land on the layers carrying all the signal routing here. ALLOW_OUT_OF_DIE forced false so a ring that does not fit hard-fails instead of silently pushing PG shapes into the integrator's padring. PDN_RAIL_WIDTH stays at its 0.6 um default: the Metal1 followpin rail is fixed by the standard cell rail and widening it shorts or blocks Metal1 pin access. WHY THIS AND NOT A DENSER MESH: halving the pitch as well (job 5370) cuts IR drop much harder (1.32 mV VDD / 0.90 mV VSS) but costs 57% of SS TNS (-336.1 -> -528.5 against control 5378) and 3.9% wirelength. MECHANISM: add_pdn_connect ties the Metal1 followpin rails up to Metal4, so every stripe crossing punches a via ladder through Metal2 and Metal3 -- the layers that actually carry signal. Halving the pitch doubled PDN special-net geometry (9572 -> 19794 shapes) and took Metal2 resource down 8.7% (255538 -> 233221); holding the pitch keeps geometry at 9900 and recovers Metal2 to 247153, cutting the TNS cost from ~192 ns to ~47 ns. Metal4/Metal5 occupancy was never the binding constraint -- Metal2 resource is. HONEST ACCOUNTING: this is bought for robustness, NOT to fix a measured problem. IR drop was already 0.10% at control. Adopted because the A40 template feeds VDD and VSS in as two localized Metal2 pin clusters at opposite edges (VSS west, VDD north), and a ring spreads that single point of entry -- which is why VSS improves 34% here while VDD does not (3.28 -> 3.61 mV, a small regression with no established mechanism; the 2.5x VDD gain in 5370 came from stripe density, not the ring). At n=1 per config some of the ~47 ns TNS delta is placement/repair lottery, not the PDN (note 5379's WNS came in 1.04 ns BETTER than its control). PITCH RELAXATION ALSO TESTED AND REJECTED (2026-09-02, jobs 5393/5394): with the ring in place, sparser stripes were tried on the theory that the ring removes the need for stripe count. It does not help. Pitch x1.4 (5394) is a clean signoff but SS TNS -388.3 vs -383.5 here, i.e. no gain -- the predicted mechanism DID fire (-0.80 % wirelength, -0.53 % vias, ~18 % fewer via ladders) but cannot move a TNS dominated by cell delay at a starved SS corner. Pitch x1.2 (5393) FAILED outright in detailed routing on DRT-0073 clkbuf_2_1_0_IQ_CLK_regs/I. So the pitch is flat in the sparse direction and expensive in the dense direction: 153.6/153.18 is where it stays. Do not re-propose in either direction without a new mechanism -- see planning/pdn-thickening-and-core-ring-2026-09.md section 3.1.
_comment_core_margin: The core ring is paid for out of the core margin, NOT out of the die: DIE_AREA stays 1675x1110 and the A40 pin coordinates are untouched. A ring needs offset + 2*width + spacing = 2+5+2+5 = 14 um per side. The baseline vertical margin (TOP/BOTTOM_MARGIN_MULT 4 x 3.92 um row = 15.68 um) ALREADY CLEARS THAT, so it is left alone and the core loses no height; only the horizontal multiplier moves, 12 -> 27 (6.72 -> 15.12 um), giving core 1644.8 x 1078.6 um -- about 1.0% of core area, util 65.4% -> 66.1%. THIS IS WHY THE RING IS 5 um AND NOT WIDER: at 9 um it needs 22 um per side, forcing the vertical margin up too, costing 4.4% of core area and pushing util to ~69% -- job 5367 died in detailed routing with DRT-0073 (no access point for clkbuf_regs_0_IQ_CLK/I). See _comment_density: 72% hit DRT-0073/DRT-1231 on this die and 65% is what cleared it, so core area here is routability budget, not spare room. Do not widen the ring without re-proving detailed routing.
